title: Automatic Updater notification file sent
description: This event is compatible with Mastercard's Automatic Billing Updater (ABU) and Visa Account Updater (VAU) features, ensuring that customer information is up-to-date across multiple sites. This event occurs daily if there is a change in card status—Pismo sends a file with the reasons for the updates to Mastercard or Visa. If no changes occur, no file will be sent and this event will not be generated. For more information, see the ABU section in the Cards overview guide or the Mastercard Automatic Billing Updater documentation.

filename.title: Automatic updater file name
filename.description: AU file name if card was sent to the card network

reason_code.title: Automatic updater reason code
reason_code.description: Reason for automatic update: `I` = initial load (Mastercard only); `N` = new account (Mastercard only); `C` = closed account; `R` = replacement when card is reissued (Mastercard only); `A` = replacement when card is reissued (Visa only); `E` = expiration date update; `O` = opt-out; `B` = opt back in (Visa only).
